_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

chatgpt_usd.basis: ChatGPT Enterprise from Carahsoft, dollars, per the agenda item

darwin_usd.basis: the Darwin AI governance platform from Carahsoft, dollars, per the agenda item

microsoft_usd.basis: Microsoft Enterprise from SHI Government Solutions, dollars, per the agenda item

reserve_usd.basis: the amount held for approved growth, dollars, per the agenda item

ceiling_usd.basis: the not to exceed total, dollars, per the agenda item

population_2024.basis: the Census Bureau's 2024 population estimate for the city of Plano

darwin_cents_per_chat_dollar.basis: computed: Darwin AI's dollars over ChatGPT Enterprise's dollars, in whole cents per dollar

darwin_pct_of_ceiling.basis: computed: Darwin AI's share of the ceiling, whole percent

chatgpt_pct_of_ceiling.basis: computed: ChatGPT Enterprise's share of the ceiling, whole percent

microsoft_pct_of_ceiling.basis: computed: Microsoft's share of the ceiling, whole percent

reserve_pct_of_ceiling.basis: computed: the reserve's share of the ceiling, whole percent

chat_plus_darwin_usd.basis: computed: ChatGPT Enterprise plus Darwin AI, dollars

chat_minus_darwin_usd.basis: computed: how many dollars more the chatbot line is than the governance line

ceiling_cents_per_resident.basis: computed: the ceiling over the 2024 population estimate, whole cents

darwin_cents_per_resident.basis: computed: Darwin AI's dollars over the 2024 population estimate, whole cents

chatgpt_cents_per_resident.basis: computed: ChatGPT Enterprise's dollars over the 2024 population estimate, whole cents

ceiling_usd_per_resident.basis: computed: the ceiling over the 2024 population estimate, dollars to two decimals

lines_on_item.basis: counted: the four money lines the agenda item names

unit_usd.basis: computed: the greatest common divisor of the four lines, dollars per drawn weight, equal to the Microsoft line

chatgpt_units.basis: computed: ChatGPT Enterprise in weights of unit_usd

darwin_units.basis: computed: Darwin AI in weights of unit_usd

microsoft_units.basis: computed: Microsoft in weights of unit_usd

reserve_units.basis: computed: the reserve in weights of unit_usd

ceiling_units.basis: computed: the ceiling in weights of unit_usd

chat_minus_darwin_units.basis: computed: the chatbot line less the watcher line, in weights
